## Change

Describe the user-visible outcome and the smallest relevant implementation boundary.

## Verification

List the checks run and any supported environment not exercised.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change preserves local-first, deterministic, read-only defaults unless an approved contract explicitly changes them.
- [ ] New fixtures and examples are neutral, synthetic, or already public.
- [ ] No private, customer-specific, proprietary, credential, or sensitive repository content is included.
- [ ] Public-contract or diagnostic changes include focused tests and documentation.
- [ ] Outputs remain bounded, explainable, and fail closed where authority or disclosure is ambiguous.
- [ ] No package publication, tag, release, credential, or privileged workflow is introduced without explicit approval.
